$comment: Hand-maintained rates that win over the fetched pricing sources.
No vendor among OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI publishes machine-readable
pricing, so the generated table is only as good as the aggregators behind it.
Put a rate here when you have read it off the vendor's own pricing page and
it disagrees with what was fetched, or when a model isn't listed upstream.
Rates are PER MILLION TOKENS, exactly as vendors quote them: $3.50 per 1M is
3.5, not 0.0000035. The generator converts. A value below 0.001 is rejected
Record 'source' and 'checked' on every entry. The generator warns about any
entry undated or confirmed over 180 days ago, and tells you when an override
has become identical to what upstream now returns so you can delete it.
Model ids match the generated table's keys: 'openai/gpt-4o',
